verdict.rationale: Cursor is a desktop IDE (a VS Code fork per community comments). Its docs cite inspecting diffs before merge, and describe an Agents Window and IDE where worktrees let 'several agents on the same repo' run in isolated checkouts in parallel, with subagents also usable in the editor. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the visual diff-review UI, explicit evidence of a side-by-side multi-session layout, and independent hands-on corroboration.
